text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Arghh! I know I can run better than that!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to tell me that. I was
there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... um... Sorry, that was
embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
But, well, I'm still growing and
improving, so it's
fine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So I'm bound to keep embarrassing
myself as I
struggle and struggle—as I
keep trying my
hardest... harder than
anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep going until the day I can beat
Opera O,
Doto, and you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I won't let my fans down! Because I'm
Narita Top
Road!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to be like that, then let
me say
something too.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As the Arima Kinen draws to a close, so
too does
the year... and a new season
begins.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, y-yes... um... Opera O?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Our era is nowhere near over.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That goes for all of us—you, Ayabe,
myself...
even Top Road.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let's compete again, as many times

countable—for we are an unending
quartet!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The radiance of our four stars will shine
bright,
even in the light of day.
